jobs.label: IC2_messages_v2
jobs.prompt: Copy exactly the icon style of the 2009 feature phone main menu in the reference images: cheap low-detail 3D render, hard glossy plastic highlights, slightly crude shapes, strong saturated primary colours, thin dark outline, small drop shadow, no square tile. Draw ONE icon in that style: a white envelope, open at the top, with a folded white letter sheet with a few grey text lines sticking out of it, and a small yellow star sparkle (new message). Big, centred, on a perfectly flat solid magenta background (#FF00FF). No text, no letters, no logos.
